paragraphs.text: Shadows over Innistrad is accompanied by Booster Battle Packs . The Booster Battle Packs contain two Welcome Deck 2016 sample decks and two Shadows over Innistrad booster packs .

Each sample deck contains basic lands , commons , 4 uncommons and 1 rare . Besides the Welcome Deck 2016 cards the decks also contain cards from Battle for Zendikar , Oath of the Gatewatch and Shadows over Innistrad .
The Shadows over Innistrad Booster Battle Packs themselves are not available at Wizards Play Network stores, but only at large "big-box" stores like Walmart or Target.
